title: Filtered interval cardinality recurrence
statement: Let $p$ be a decidable predicate on the natural numbers, and let $u<K$ be natural numbers. The number of elements of the half-open interval $[u,K)$ satisfying $p$ equals $1$ if $p(u)$ holds and $0$ otherwise, plus the number of elements of $[u+1,K)$ satisfying $p$.
